security_invariants_tested.statement: Pure meta commands (help, settings, history, diagnostics, etc.) execute strictly inside AstraRun internal UI layer with zero calls to ExecutionBroker or ActionGate.
security_invariants_tested.evidence: tests/au1/test_au1_1a_meta_security.py::test_meta_command_structural_isolation verified mock_broker_exec.call_count == 0 across all meta commands.

security_invariants_tested.statement: Composite commands containing meta keywords (e.g. 'help and open notepad', 'show diagnostics then delete file') never bypass workstation safety policies and must classify as OPERATIONAL_GOAL.
security_invariants_tested.evidence: tests/au1/test_au1_1a_meta_security.py::test_composite_meta_not_handled_by_meta_handler verified composite queries route to OPERATIONAL_GOAL with COMPOSITE_CONTAINS_OPERATIONAL_CLAUSE.

security_invariants_tested.statement: Production delegation has no default mock fallback and fails honestly with PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE instead of silently executing unauthenticated advisory output.
